name.english: Graduated income tax rates for individuals
name.filipino: Graduated na income tax rates para sa mga indibidwal
name.taglish: Graduated income tax rates para sa individuals

applies_to: Resident citizens, non-resident citizens and resident aliens taxed on taxable income under the graduated rates (compensation earners, and self-employed individuals who did not elect the 8% option).

kb_references.title: BIR_Income_Tax_FAQ
kb_references.what: Computation steps: gross income less allowable deductions = net taxable income; x tax rate = income tax due; less tax withheld (BIR Form 2316) = income tax payable (Question 10, Part A).

label.english: TRAIN schedule for tax years 2018 to 2022
label.filipino: TRAIN schedule para sa taong 2018 hanggang 2022
label.taglish: TRAIN schedule para sa tax years 2018 to 2022

versions.legal_basis: Sec. 24(A)(2)(a), NIRC of 1997 as amended by Sec. 5 of RA No. 10963 (TRAIN Law): schedule effective January 1, 2018 until December 31, 2022

sources.title: Republic Act No. 10963 (TRAIN Law), Sec. 5 amending Sec. 24(A)(2)(a) NIRC
Senate Tax Study and Research Office, Primer on the TRAIN Law (March 2018)

verification.notes: The RA 10963 text as published reads 'Over P2,000,000 but not over P5,000,000' for the 32% bracket, while the next bracket starts 'Over P8,000,000' with a P2,410,000 base. P490,000 + 32% x (P8,000,000 - P2,000,000) = P2,410,000, so the upper bound must be P8,000,000; the Senate STSRO primer states P8,000,000. The loader re-checks this arithmetic for every bracket.
